ALAB Astera Labs China tariff OR trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: Astera FY2025 10-K 風險揭露：Chinese customers facing tariffs may build their own products or buy from competitors, and may cancel or delay orders; prolonged or expanded export restrictions would hurt revenue and results.
Astera S-1 揭露：美國對部分中國客戶的銷售限制，使部分銷售可能需出口許可，且不保證獲准；並提及中國不可靠實體清單風險。
findings.excerpt: Due to the U.S. government restricting sales to certain customers in China, sales to some of our customers may require licenses in order for us to export our products; however, there can be no assurances that requests for licenses will be approved by the U.S. government.

findings.claim: Q1 2025 法說：管理層稱中國出口限制對 retimer 出貨（連結 merchant GPU 系統）屬小幅逆風，終端客戶中國曝險低於營收 10%，尚未見關稅重大影響。
findings.source: Fintool Astera Labs Q1 2025 earnings summary

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 稱半導體關稅可能降低產品需求，美國對關鍵礦物的關稅可能推高投入成本。
2026-01-14 公告對一小類先進半導體及含其衍生產品課 25% Section 232 關稅，2026-01-15 生效；適用範圍窄，搜尋結果未顯示 Astera 產品是否在涵蓋範圍內。
findings.source: White & Case; EY Tax News, 25% Section 232 tariff on certain advanced semiconductors
findings.excerpt: Effective 12:01 a.m. EST on 15 January 2026, a 25% ad valorem tariff applies to certain advanced computing chips and specified derivative products.

note: 未找到 Astera 被列入 Entity List 或被點名於 2026 年 Section 232 的來源。
